Time runs from left to right: there is a labelled grid line every 30 minutes and lighter lines every 10 and 5 minutes. Each horizontal line is a station, and the stations are spaced by distance. Each coloured line is one train. A line that slopes down to the right is a train running from Kingsbridge towards Aldermoor; a line that slopes up to the right runs the other way. A horizontal stretch on a station line is the train standing at that station. A train's number is printed where its line starts: above the top station line for trains starting at Kingsbridge, below the bottom station line for trains starting at Aldermoor. The legend gives the colour of each kind of train. A line that ends at a station in the middle of the chart is a train that terminates there, and a line that reaches the right-hand edge is a train still running when the chart ends.

A train is overtaken when it stands at a station while a train running in the same direction passes it.
